summary: Both edits carry every part of the intent with nothing added, and the two arms match in content. There is some repetition across the UI and validation entries, plus one small placement doubt in fresh, where the booker-form part sits on form-builder rather than booker-ui.

findings.detail: "so a booking with a valid required phone number can be confirmed without asking the attendee for an email address" and "Keep the email-confirmation path working for event types that select it" are each stated on two entries in each arm.

"Carry the phone-versus-email requirement choice made in the booking-field editor into the booker form" is on form-builder, while the graph has booker-ui [booker-ui], which owns BookEventForm/. This is defensible because form-builder also lists BookEventForm/BookingFields.tsx, but booker-ui is the more direct home, and chain uses it.
